Subject: ClearForge payment setup & remittance format

Thanks again for the warm onboarding call earlier. Per our discussion, attaching the signed bank letter and our completed W-9. We prefer ACH for US payouts; wires are OK for international rollouts. Below are the ACH/Wire details and our remittance expectations so your AP team can map invoices correctly:

- Bank name: North Coast Commercial Bank
- Account name: ClearForge Systems Inc.
- Account number (ending): ****4821
- Routing (ACH): 121000358
- Wire ABA: 021000021
- SWIFT (for wires): NCCBUS44

Remittance CSV (sample attached): columns we will accept on your side — invoice_id, po_number, invoice_date, total_amount, remit_notes. We can also ingest an XML if necessary but CSV is easiest for our ERP.

A couple of asks from our finance team:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will push PO numbers in the AP remittance payload (we typically reconcile against PO references)?
2) Do you require micro-deposits or is the bank letter sufficient to activate ACH?

Attachments: ClearForge_BankLetter_20280720.pdf (bank letter, stamped), ClearForge_W9_20280720.pdf, clearforge_remit_sample.csv

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-min call if easier.

Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700

Hi Lena —

Thanks for sending the documents and the sample CSV. Quick notes from FinOps here:

- We can accept the bank letter to enable ACH, but our standard is to also run a $0- or micro-deposit verification for new payees to confirm routing when ACH is used. If you prefer to skip micro-deposits we can accept the bank letter + a one-time bank call verification; choose whichever is faster for you.
- We will include the PO number in the remittance payload under the field po_number. Please confirm the exact CSV header name you will parse (you used "po_number" in the sample — that works).
- For reconciliation, we recommend including the invoice_id and po_number on each invoice. Our payments platform attaches a remittance CSV to every payment; your sample matches our requirements.

Next steps for us:
1) Marissa (cc'd) will open the vendor profile and request either micro-deposit activation or bank-letter verification.
2) Jordan will create the PO template and confirm how PO numbers appear in our payload (we'll share a test remittance once active).

If you send a short confirmation that micro-deposits are OK (or that you prefer bank-letter-only activation), we can move this today.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Supplier Onboarding | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Office: +1 (628) 555-0198

Confirming our remittance sample uses these exact headers: invoice_id, po_number, invoice_date, total_amount, remit_notes.

Also attaching an updated bank letter that includes an ACH confirmation line per your team's request. Let me know once you initiate the micro-deposit and we'll confirm receipt on our side.
